rules.rule:
Specialized optimization directives for modules/agent_ui.py (Terminal UI, Spinners, Session Box, Key Reading).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Data-driven 6-tuple STYLES matrix; (2) Precomputed static _WAVE_PATTERN in CalmBoatSpinner and batched style-grouping in _glimmer; (3) Non-flushing multi-packet escape byte buffering with TCSADRAIN in _read_fd(); (4) Resilient string partition('|||') in run_interactive_selection(); (5) 30s TTL memoization on get_local_model_name() to prevent render stalls; (6) Atomic frame buffer accumulation in select_workspace_profile(); (7) Explicit EOF and KeyboardInterrupt guards in interactive loops; (8) Threading stop_event in InlineSpinner.
PRIORITIZE: (1) Minimizing Rich layout recalculations in session box rendering; (2) Precomputing static color escapes.
DO NOT SACRIFICE: (1) Raw termios single-key reading; (2) Guaranteed cursor restoration (\033[?25h) in finally blocks; (3) Clean error propagation.

Specialized optimization directives for modules/agent_stream.py (Streaming SSE, ANSI Geometry & Rich Streamer).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Correct state transitions between reasoning deltas and answer content (closing <think> on reasoning-to-content switch); (2) Subclassing Markdown as AgentMarkdown instead of mutating global _RM.elements; (3) rich.cells.cell_len() line-width calculation and terminal viewport height clamping in get_cursor_up_count(); (4) Multi-line code keyword threshold in prepare_markdown(); (5) Instance-cached self.show_thinking on RichStreamer; (6) Narrow terminal border length clamping (<60 cols) in _get_think_borders(); (7) Multi-marker checking in TOOL_MARKERS with paired tags in RE_TOOL_CALL_BLOCK; (8) List chunk accumulators (_acc_think_parts, _acc_ans_parts) with property accessors preventing quadratic string copy; (9) 10s TTL memoization on _get_code_theme() avoiding global state locks per code block; (10) Guarded .replace() containment checks on tool markers; (11) Closing thinking borders on interrupted exit paths; (12) Preserving parts[0] pre-tag tokens in in_post_think.
PRIORITIZE: (1) Fast token passing in _process_stream_chunk without redundant string copying; (2) Minimizing Rich layout recalculations in CleanCodeBlock and Markdown.
DO NOT SACRIFICE: Viewport clamping math or accurate stream phase transitions.

Specialized optimization directives for modules/agent_core.py (Agentic Turn Loop & Stream Parsing).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Unified _handle_sse_payload handling both stream loop and trailing unbuffered events; (2) Passing healed_args_list directly to tool execution without json.loads round-trips; (3) Explicit prefix checks on [denied] User declined/Action cancelled to avoid false-positive content aborts; (4) Dynamic rem_clock socket timeout calculation respecting turn wall-clock limits; (5) Post-prune _sanitize_tool_history() ensuring assistant tool_calls and tool results stay paired; (6) Stripping ANSI/control sequences from HTTP error bodies; (7) _heal_tool_args() contract returning dict mappings with _parse_error on invalid inputs; (8) Thread-local requests.Session pooling.
PRIORITIZE: (1) Fast token estimation shortcuts before falling back to full iteration; (2) Compact error logging without duplicating stack unwinds.
DO NOT TOUCH: (1) Security confirmation gates; (2) Mandatory tool-call/result pairing integrity.

Specialized optimization directives for modules/agent_adapters.py (Self-Healing Parser & Argument Adapter).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Multi-pass fallback architecture (direct JSON -> markdown fence unwrap -> XML tag strip -> heredoc parser -> regex); (2) Intentional relaxed regexes designed to tolerate broken SLM output formats; (3) Extracting only the first contiguous hunk in _extract_diff_hunk(); (4) Stack-based unclosed JSON repair preserving all nested openers and stripping trailing escape backslashes; (5) Bounded linear bailout checks in _extract_balanced_json(); (6) Restricting cd stripping strictly to sandbox roots (RE_SAFE_CD_COMMAND); (7) State-machine diff parsing preserving '---'/'+++' lines inside hunk bodies; (8) Capped AST candidate evaluation (max_ast_parses) in _extract_ast_python_calls(); (9) Rejecting '..' traversal path components in path normalization and shell-to-write conversions.
PRIORITIZE: (1) Fast-path JSON decoding so well-formed JSON arguments skip regex passes entirely; (2) Single-pass gutter stripping in _strip_line_number_gutters().
DO NOT SACRIFICE: Parser resilience across Hermes, DSML, XML, and markdown formats.

Specialized optimization directives for ai-agent.py (Main CLI Runtime, REPL Loop & Command Dispatcher).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Zero-fork load_env_file() reading ~/.config/py-agent/.env; (2) Transient terminal prompt cursor repositioning escapes in _clear_transient_status(); (3) Readline history hook configuration; (4) SQLite read-only URI connections in workspace_db_counts(); (5) Non-destructive merge in ensure_clean_agent_dir() preserving existing .agent/history.md; (6) Independent isolated try-blocks for sub-agent worktree and session lock cleanup in clean_exit(); (7) os.chdir() verification before updating workspace path state; (8) Requiring '/' prefix for single-letter commands in RE_THINK_BIN; (9) Rolling back dangling user turn in chat_history when stream_response fails or aborts; (10) Lazy _load_agent_modules() in run_matching_search() keeping shell hooks sub-millisecond.
PRIORITIZE: (1) Fast-path query regex matching in main REPL loop; (2) Efficient session lock sweep logic avoiding unnecessary process probes.
DO NOT SACRIFICE: Clean terminal exit hygiene or sub-agent git worktree cleanup.

Specialized optimization directives for CLI visualizers (Media player, Stopwatch).
PRIORITIZE: (1) Replacing math-heavy trigonometric recalculations per frame with lookup arrays; (2) Single-buffer stdout flushing using terminal alternate screens; (3) Reducing line count in ASCII banner matrices.

Global Python Optimization Policy:
PRIORITIZE: (1) Making less lines do more using modern Python 3.10+ idioms (structural pattern matching, dictionary unions, comprehensions); (2) Moving heavy imports inside functions if they are not needed on the instant-start CLI path; (3) Replacing manual loops with built-in standard library utilities (itertools, collections).
DO NOT INTRODUCE: Third-party dependencies (numpy, Cython, asyncio frameworks) outside existing py-agent stack.
